name: Global Summit on Obesity, Diabetes & Weight Management
tagline: Global Summit on Obesity, Diabetes & Weight Management
theme_primary: The Cardiometabolic Era: Advances in Obesity, Diabetes, and Weight Management
theme_blurb: The Cardiometabolic Era: Advances in Obesity, Diabetes, and Weight Management — uniting endocrinology, cardiology and lifestyle medicine in the GLP-1 generation.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening endocrinologists, nutritionists and metabolic scientists shaping the future of weight care.
about_heading: Where metabolic medicine meets the next decade.
about_lead: GSOD 2027 is a global forum for pioneering research, clinical translation and cross-disciplinary dialogue across obesity, diabetes and weight management.
about_body: Across two days of keynotes, parallel technical tracks, poster sessions and applied workshops, we convene the brightest minds to chart the frontier of metabolic care.
